name: AIManagedAgents-Agent
description: A website monitoring and operations agent run by AI Managed Agents, which its own page describes as "a service of Momentum's AI division". It makes read-only requests to public pages, states it does not collect content for model training, does not sign in to the sites it monitors and does not answer or work around CAPTCHAs or other bot challenges. Its daily monitoring check is deliberately shaped so a site can tell signed from unsigned traffic: it reads robots.txt and requests the home page twice, once signed and once a few seconds later unsigned, under the same user agent.
